body:
## Changes

* feat: add `--lines` flag to `dprint fmt` for range formatting (#1329)
* feat: check for newer remote configuration files and add `--reload[=config|plugins]` flag (#1328)
* feat: support npm specifiers in `extends` (#1332)
* feat: add riscv64gc-unknown-linux-musl builds (#1323)
* feat: add s390x-unknown-linux-gnu builds (#1324)
* feat: add FreeBSD x86_64 and aarch64 builds (#1325)
* perf: compile wasm plugin functions in parallel (#1315)
* perf: load cached wasm plugins in parallel (#1316)
* perf: wake the fs lock keep-alive thread immediately on release (#1317)
* perf: memory map cached wasm plugins on unix (#1318)
* perf: read the .npmrc files once per config dir instead of per npm plugin (#1320)
* fix: format explicit paths outside the `--config` file's directory with only its unanchored patterns (#1314)
* fix: accept npm: specifiers in the `--plugins` CLI flag (#1319)
* fix: kill process plugin subprocesses so shutdown cannot hang (#1311)
* fix: improve generated shell completions (#1331)
* fix: detect the plugin file a package ships when updating an npm plugin (#1334)
* fix: warn when using old dprint-plugin-gofumpt versions (#1310)

## Install

Run `dprint upgrade` or see https://dprint.dev/install/

## Verification

These artifacts have [build provenance attestations](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-for-github-actions/using-artifact-attestations/using-artifact-attestations-to-establish-provenance-for-builds).
Verify a download with the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/):

```shell
gh attestation verify dprint-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip --repo dprint/dprint
```
